title: Portable archive contract
summary: Portable archives carry manifest-bound QA and shared-file bytes across local, self-host and hosted moves. Validation checks digests, import uses destination storage, and missing files are reported. Two-member backup archives remain valid. Hosted Prepare archive checks size before pausing, caps archives at 10 GiB, and issues a signed link valid for one hour; Import fetches from configured buckets and restores artifacts before serving. Every mode exports only public database objects, excluding capability-secret data, environment instrumentation, extensions and source-authority fence state; import rejects nonportable catalog entries. Export and estimate keep confirmed absent bytes as artifact_source_absent and unavailable handles or owners as artifact_handle_or_owner_unavailable. Other read failures refuse with archive_artifact_unreadable and access or checkout recovery; files over the per-file limit refuse with archive_artifact_too_large. Local and self-host exports can exclude artifacts explicitly to bypass file transfer. Hosted Prepare archive has no exclusion; when it refuses with export_size_limit or export_disk_limit, prune old records with yoke universe prune --apply, then Prepare archive again. A refused paused export keeps the source paused and names universe resume. Destination mode determines import and credential authority: yoke universe import ARCHIVE replaces a selected local universe and binds its machine owner as admin; yoke self-host import ARCHIVE --dir BUNDLE requires stopped destination core and returns one fresh admin token. Both revoke copied API tokens and browser sessions. Hosted Import also revokes copied credentials and requires reconnecting and signing in through destination authority.
